integrity: Analytical proof of the finite formula, strict transition and asymptotic constant. Exact finite enumerations reproduce samples but cannot establish the universal theorem. The originality comparison is targeted and cannot establish absolute uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Two independent equal-length with-replacement surveys, uniform positive species probabilities, exactly \(m\ge2\) species; statements are not claimed for heterogeneous or correlated surveys, fixed-population sampling, Jaccard-ratio covariance, or finite-sample inference.
title: A strict effort threshold for covariance of shared and pooled species richness
